message:
You know that one friend who turns every storm into a mini natural disaster movie? I love her dearly, but when the weather report mentions a slight chance of rain, she’s already got a survival kit packed with snacks, flashlights, and a full playlist of soothing tunes. 

Last winter, as we braced for a snowstorm, I calmly pulled out my trusty old snow shovel and a few hot cocoa packets. 

While she was busy making ‘emergency’ cookies, I realized that a little preparation can go a long way without turning into a full-blown panic. 

So, I guess my tip is: keep it light, stay prepared, and remember, sometimes a cozy evening with a good book is the best plan of all. What’s your go-to tip for when the weather gets a little wild?
